items.detail: PatentTerminalParseError: Paragraphs 18-41 and FIG. 1 disclose a generic seven-lens architecture and governing conditions, but no embodiment-specific ordered optical prescription; the complete official source contains 100 consecutively numbered paragraphs, 20 claims, 21 numbered tables, one MathML object, zero HTML image tags and 10 declared figure panels on nine exact drawing-sheet rasters. No value is inferred, measured from a raster drawing, or borrowed from another family

PatentTerminalParseError: Paragraphs 42-49 and Tables 1-5 disclose imaging lens system 100a; the exact official source publishes ordered radius, thickness, Nd, Vd, per-surface Y Aperture and focal-length rows, A-J asphere coefficients, and EFL/Fno/HFOV metadata. However, none of its 21 tables, 100 numbered paragraphs or 20 claims contains the word stop or diaphragm or identifies a stop axial coordinate; exact FIGS. 1-5 page rasters likewise contain no STO or stop-plane label. Y Aperture is a per-surface effective aperture, not an axial stop location. No stop value is inferred from Fno, measured from a raster drawing, or borrowed from another family, so no formal ZMX is permitted
